events_list.title: Welch Crystallization Symposium 2026
events_list.preview: We are pleased to announce that the annual Welch Crystallization Symposium will take place on October 9, 2026.

body.lead_text:
The Welch Center for Advanced Bioactive Materials Crystallization is pleased to announce the 2nd Welch Crystallization Symposium, which will be held on Friday, October 9, 2026, at the University of Houston in Houston, Texas.

The symposium will focus on key areas of crystallization science, including nucleation, polymorphism, and crystal engineering, while highlighting recent advances and emerging challenges in pharmaceutical and materials applications.

Following the tremendous success of last year's inaugural event, which welcomed more than 100 participants from the pharmaceutical industry, academia, and the student community, this year's symposium will feature an expanded program of scientific presentations, networking opportunities, and research showcases.

Featured Speakers and Program
The symposium will include presentations from distinguished scientists representing leading pharmaceutical companies, including Pfizer, Eli Lilly, AbbVie, Merck, GSK and Takeda.

The program will also feature presentations from the Welch Center's Principal Investigators, as well as student poster presentations highlighting innovative research across a broad range of crystallization-related topics.

Registration 
Online registration for the symposium is available at https://forms.gle/FVkDQJKdbjSJ1DPS9; and there is no registration fee. 

Poster Presentations and Business Showcases
Attendees are invited to present either a research poster or a business showcase at no cost.

Research Posters

Participate in the dedicated poster session from 1:00 PM to 2:30 PM
Share your latest research findings with academic and industry audiences
Engage directly with experts in crystallization science
Showcase materials will be prominently exhibited at the entrance to the symposium venue

Participants will have the opportunity to:

Learn about the latest developments in crystallization research
Connect with scientists from industry and academia
Explore collaborative opportunities
Gain insight into ongoing research at the Welch Center for Advanced Bioactive Materials Crystallization
Engage with students, faculty, and industry professionals from across the crystallization community

If you are unable to attend, we encourage you to share this announcement with colleagues and collaborators who may benefit from participating.

We look forward to welcoming you to the University of Houston for a day of scientific exchange, collaboration, and innovation in crystallization science.

Register today and join us on October 9, 2026.
